content.short: 0xTeam conducts multichain smart contract audits and security assessments for tokens, NFTs, and DeFi platforms.
content.description: 0xTeam helps blockchain projects stay secure by identifying and resolving vulnerabilities across smart contracts, tokens, NFTs, and DeFi platforms. They conduct security audits and assessments to detect weaknesses before they can be exploited. The team performs multichain audits across networks including Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon, and others, allowing projects to focus on growth while security review is handled by specialists. By delivering thorough findings and actionable guidance, 0xTeam aims to protect assets, prevent hacks, and build trust with users across ecosystems.
content.meta: 0xTeam provides multichain smart contract security audits across major chains. Discover 0xTeam and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
